reason: As someone who has quit similar services, A answers my real worries: no contract, skip or cancel any time, meal swaps, order deadline, delivery area, and a call with the dietitian before paying, while being just as honest about the small A1C sample. B is honest too but leaves out those details, slightly misstates the 0.6 average as applying to the ten who improved, and ends on boilerplate disclaimers.
